"{var:1}... You've grown so reliable while I was away.
"...I'll give you this.
{var:1} received Lorelei's harp!
"I found that harp on my travels. I really wanted to give it to you.
"You probably know already, but using it at a pillar of light at sea should take your ship to new places.
"Let's find the rest of our friends there. To beat Mordegon and bring peace back to the world...!

Jade rejoined the party!
Jade's Character Builder panels were newly unlocked!
And so, thanks to {var:1}, Octagonia regained its old liveliness.
The people turned into monsters returned to human form and shared the joy of their first peaceful time in ages.
